The following events took place in approximately '''100,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] civilization begins on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*Roughly around this time, the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] accomplish a number of feats:<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the construction of [[Centerpoint Station]] using the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]],<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> the subsequent construction of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] using Centerpoint, the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]] and its [[Cosmic Turbine]], the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], and the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]] [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] cluster was also constructed with Centerpoint during the Celestials' era of power to contain [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] entity known as [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
*The [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] species achieves interstellar spaceflight and surveys the "primitive" people of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and Notron, known by that point as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, they are disappointed by the developing Human and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] civilizations and return to their homeworld of [[Columus/Legends|Columus]] in isolation.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*Around this time, the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] expand out from the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]] and the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], planting their indestructible pyramids on planets such as [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. However, the Sharu bury their cities and revert to a primitive state in an attempt to avoid the attention of the Celestials.<ref name="Atlas" />
*The winged [[thrantcill]]s are first recorded flying south for winter on Coruscant.<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>
*The [[Muurshantre Extinction]] occurs, destroying the [[Taurannik Codex]] and scattering its remains.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
*By 100,000 BBY, the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] had built an [[Infinity Gate]]&mdash;the [[Prime Gate]] in a network of similar devices, used by them as a means of interstellar travel and as [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]].<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|DAT 1-4|Dathomir}}</ref>
